entries.subject: Size: estimate from the JPL Horizons magnitude and an assumed albedo
entries.finding: Chaldene is drawn as a sphere of about 4.0 km diameter (radius 2 km), estimated from the apparent magnitude JPL Horizons gives for body 521 (23.769 on 2026-Sep-03, H = 16.1 with no phase term) and an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04. The size is not measured, and ignoring the phase term slightly understates it.
